name: Reflect
description: End-to-end encrypted networked notes, daily notes, bookmarks, books, backlinks, tasks, and knowledge capture through Reflect.
agentUseSummary: Connect once through Relay-owned OAuth for graph metadata and append-only cloud capture. On Mac, Reflect's separate desktop MCP can additionally provide device-local decrypted search, reading, and editing without routing plaintext through Railway.

capabilities.label: Read graph metadata
capabilities.description: Verify the connected user and list graphs, books, and bookmarks without claiming decrypted note access.

capabilities.label: Cloud capture
capabilities.description: Create bookmarks and append or create notes through Reflect's append-only cloud API.

approvalRequired.label: Create link
approvalRequired.description: Create one bookmark in a selected graph.

approvalRequired.label: Append daily note
approvalRequired.description: Append bounded Markdown to a selected daily note.

blocked.label: Read note plaintext through Relay
blocked.description: Reflect's end-to-end encryption prevents its cloud REST API and Railway from returning decrypted note contents.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Graph metadata reads run directly; bookmark and note capture require approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected Reflect cloud action runs without Relay per-action approval; OAuth scopes, fixed origin, bounds, audits, and Reflect encryption constraints still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts selected cloud tools and proxies OAuth server-side; Mac-local MCP tools remain a separate device authority.
Railway mounts selected cloud tools and proxies OAuth server-side; Mac-local MCP tools remain a separate device authority.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay must sign into Reflect, create the production OAuth client, register the exact Railway callback, and place the client ID and secret in Railway.
providerSetup.nextAction: Sign into Reflect at the developer console, create Relay Console's OAuth client, register https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/reflect/callback, configure REFLECT_CLIENT_ID and REFLECT_CLIENT_SECRET on Railway, then run OAuth, health, one bounded read, and one approved or Dangerous-mode capture.

evidence.supports: Reflect supports OAuth 2, self-service client credentials, PKCE, Bearer access tokens, and an append-only REST model because its servers cannot decrypt note contents.
Reflect's Academy-linked API specification records the OAuth endpoints, read:graph and write:graph scopes, user/graph/bookmark reads, and bookmark/daily-note/note writes.
Reflect documents a desktop-app MCP server for Claude, Codex, and Cursor that can locally search, read, create, append, rename, edit, and delete decrypted notes.
Reflect documents end-to-end encryption, explaining why Railway cloud authority cannot read note plaintext and why local MCP must remain separate.
